motion.name: ease-editorial
motion.purpose: Canonical easing from src/components/motion/tokens.ts, registered as GSAP CustomEase. Scoped useGSAP owns timeline/reveal and utility opacity/transforms; CSS owns tactile states, React/browser View Transitions own route/shared-photo navigation, and AnimatePresence/usePresence own DOM lifetime and popLayout only.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Public button compression; --motion-press.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Soft elevation and short vertical surface feedback; --motion-hover.

motion.name: icon
motion.purpose: Arrow, pictogram and navigation-collapse response; --motion-icon.

motion.name: select
motion.purpose: Selection, wizard steps and committed result feedback; --motion-select.

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.purpose: GSAP native modal/drawer entrance; --motion-dialog-in. Scoped useGSAP cleanup preserves native dialog behavior and interrupted poses.

motion.name: dialog-out
motion.purpose: GSAP native modal/drawer exit; --motion-dialog-out. Presence retains modality, body scroll lock and focus until GSAP calls safeToRemove; exiting content rejects actions.

motion.name: page
motion.purpose: Native React/browser View Transitions own public content/shared photographs; --motion-page. Public arrival is 4px; shared photos use real record IDs. Unsupported browsers retain normal navigation with a short heading entrance. GSAP reveals a changed gallery image with opacity/4px only after its pixels decode, preserving the Image DOM and canceling stale callbacks.

motion.name: section
motion.purpose: Once-only opacity-only section-heading/promotional-copy ScrollTrigger reveal; --motion-section, once:true and immediateRender:false. Photos and listing frames stay stationary. The labeled GSAP hero timeline alone settles the plate 18px, followed by copy/search/CTA, completing in 540ms over a stationary photograph.

motion.name: card
motion.purpose: Once-only opacity-only category reveal; --motion-card. Compact grids reveal visible sibling row pairs. Content is visible by default, finished inline opacity clears, and hover/focus can finish an entrance immediately so CSS regains control.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: Actual sibling category delay; --motion-stagger. Cap total delay at 0.21s; compact grids batch one visible row pair at a time. Native scrolling only, with no pinning, scrub or scroll proxy.

motion.name: public-button
motion.purpose: Primary hover expands hard offset from 3px to 5px over 160ms; press compresses to 1px over 120ms. Secondary press is translateY(1px), without shadow. Operational, payment and destructive actions remain stable; disabled controls do not move.

motion.name: category
motion.purpose: Hover/focus retains ink frame and expands hard shadow; pictogram rises 2px/rotates -1deg and arrow moves 3px right/up. Press compresses to hard 1px offset.

motion.name: photo
motion.purpose: CSS room-photo and detail-mosaic hover scale 1.02 inside their clipped frames; touch and reduced-motion modes skip photographic hover scaling. Photographs stay stationary during scroll.

motion.name: wizard-panel
motion.purpose: GSAP directional movement; outgoing panels become inert and aria-hidden. AnimatePresence/usePresence retain DOM and popLayout positioning only, with no Motion DOM opacity/transform props. Preserve parent form values and validation; never count through incorrect monetary amounts.

motion.name: dialog-offset
motion.purpose: Entrance/exit offsets use vertical motion for modals and horizontal motion for navigation drawers. Native focus management remains authoritative.

motion.name: page-exit
motion.purpose: Public page exit fades opacity only.

motion.name: pending-navigation
motion.purpose: Two-pixel progress line only while Next Link is actually pending or local state is preparing. No artificial delay or layout space; reduced motion makes it static.

motion.name: committed-results
motion.purpose: GSAP commits filters immediately, then fades real results without stale rows. Calendar/Kanban feedback is opacity only; operational headings use a restrained 3px/160ms entrance. No Admin table-row stagger, financial counters or artificial operation delay.

motion.name: focus
motion.purpose: Visible cyan focus; photographic contexts retain an opaque backing and contrasting outline.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Live useSyncExternalStore preference subscription, gsap.matchMedia reversion and CSS remove spatial entrances, hover transforms and decorative loops. Reduced-motion safeToRemove runs in a passive effect after the Presence layout commit, including active exits. Scoped useGSAP contexts revert on unmount. View transitions are disabled, pending lines are static, essential content/results remain immediate and document scrolling uses auto.

narrative.northStar: Cool Neo-Brutalism ? Editorial Marketplace ? Layered Motion
narrative.overview:
**Cool Neo-Brutalism × Editorial Marketplace × Layered Motion** is the sole active visual direction. Restore strong geometric frames, sharp corners and selective hard offset shadows while keeping the bright cool palette, natural Studio photography, editorial typography and existing motion. Earlier all-soft/all-rounded instructions are superseded; historical reports are not competing authorities.

Preserve every approved layout, Vietnamese label, category pictogram, exact Room Unit identity, navigation, form, handler, domain/data contract and role permission. Business Policy VI v1.1 remains authoritative for behavior. This is a visual correction, not a product rebuild.
keyCharacteristics: Bright cool canvas with cyan primary and supporting blue.
Sharp public geometry, visible ink frames and selective hard offsets.
Soft functional layering; frost confined to navigation/search.
Natural photography, Bricolage lettering and meaningful geometric pictograms.
Moderate Customer surfaces and quiet opaque Host/Admin data.

rules.name: Hybrid depth
rules.body: Hard offsets define public brand geometry; soft elevation supports utility layers. Default search rows are unshadowed at rest; dense table/calendar/Kanban items receive no decorative hard offsets.

rules.name: Selective frost
rules.body: Only navigation and hero search use controlled blur with opaque fallbacks. Hero headline, transactional and financial data stay opaque.

dos: Do preserve natural photographs, exact physical room identity and clean Vietnamese lettering.
Do use hard brand shadows, soft functional shadows and the 0/4/8px radius vocabulary.
Do keep real derived counts, exact amounts, domain behavior and native form/modal semantics.
Do honor reduced motion, reduced transparency and opaque backdrop-filter fallbacks.
donts: Don't invent claims, metrics, categories or policies.
Don't restore warm retro grounds, generic rounded SaaS cards, competing dominant blue or pill-shaped branding.
Don't apply glass to financial, transactional or operational data.
Don't change booking, payment, inventory, scheduling or role authority through visual work.
